'''Kammris''' was a mineral used in the construction of [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. It was [[Mining/Legends|mined]] on [[Nkllon/Legends|Nkllon]], among other [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. Kammris was among the minerals captured from [[Nomad City]] in [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] raid on Nkllon. The [[Bilbringi Shipyards]] had previously reported being low on kammris.
